# Hugh Carrow

## Overview

- **Age:** Approximately fourteen years old  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c15 P27](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0027)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Hughie  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>

## Appearance

Hugh is a high-statured youth with wavy chestnut hair and light-brown eyes filled with mischief. He possesses a handsome face with a mouth prone to a mocking grin. His physical appearance strongly resembles that of his father, John Carrow, at the same age.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c37 P38](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0038)_

## Personality

Hugh is lively, confident, and possesses a strong streak of independence inherited from his family. He has a playful and daring temperament, frequently engaging in teasing and classroom antics, such as winking at unfamiliar girls or tying their hair to chairs. Despite his mischievous demeanor, he is honorable and willing to take responsibility for his actions, publicly confessing when he provokes others and showing remorse when he causes genuine distress.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P29](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0029), [v1 c15 P42](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0042), [v1 c15 P49](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0049), [v1 c37 P40](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0040)_

## Traits

- Handsome  <sub>[v1 c15 P29](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0029), [v1 c37 P38](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0038)</sub>
- Mischievous  <sub>[v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028)</sub>

- Remorseful when wrong  <sub>[v1 c15 P42](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0042), [v1 c15 P49](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0049)</sub>

## Abilities

- Strong academic potential  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>

## History

Four years prior to joining Brierley school, Hugh accompanied his ill father to Alberta, where they spent three years and he missed much of his regular schooling. Upon returning, he enrolled at Brierley school in the fourth book despite being nearly fourteen years old. During class, he played pranks such as surreptitiously tying Opal Pettigrew's blonde plait to her chair. Later that day, he tried to get the attention of Nell Harcourt, who was lost in a daydream, by pulling her hair and calling her 'carrots'. Furious, Nell struck him on the head with her slate, breaking the slate. Hugh defended Nell to Mr. Pidgeon by admitting that he had provoked her, but the teacher punished Nell regardless. After class, Hugh waited at the door to apologize to Nell and ask her not to remain angry, though she haughtily ignored his plea.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P31](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0031), [v1 c15 P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 c15 P34](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0034), [v1 c15 P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), [v1 c15 P42](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0042), [v1 c15 P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 c15 P48](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0048), [v1 c15 P49](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0049), [v1 c15 P50](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0050)_

- Lived in Alberta for three years due to his father's ill health  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>
